title: ARRIVE
focus_line: Hope is the confident expectation in God's promises, anchored in Christ.

verse.text: For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

session.prompt: Picture the long-awaited promise arriving not as an army but as a newborn — see the child who carries the weight of the world on His shoulders and the hope of generations in His cry.

coaching_notes: The greatest spiritual moments in your life most likely started with something small that seemed insignificant. Look for the small moments where God is at work right now.
